$sources: ACI 350-06 Code Requirements for Environmental Engineering Concrete Structures: the RC water tanks' design (alpha 9 track C12); the building services' values stay the default pack's

sources.tanks.cover: ACI 350-06 7.7.1: 50 mm (2 in) on walls and slabs in contact with the liquid or the weather; f'c at least 28 MPa (4 000 psi, Sec 4.2)
sources.tanks.againstEarth: ACI 350-06 7.7.1: 75 mm (3 in) cast against and permanently exposed to earth
sources.tanks.maxSpacing: ACI 350-06 7.6.5 and 10.6.4: bars at most 3h and 300 mm (12 in) apart
sources.tanks.maxWaterCement: ACI 350-06 Table 4.2.2: w/cm at most 0.45 (normal exposure; 0.40 severe)
sources.tanks.combinations: ACI 350-06 9.2.1 (the ACI 318 strength combinations with F at the factor of D and H at 1.6) and 9.2.6 (service); W = 0
sources.tanks.steelStress: ACI 350-06 9.2.6 (crackControl steelStress): the service stress of the bars at most 138 MPa (20 ksi) in direct (hoop) tension, normal environmental exposure; flexure taken at the same 20 ksi, the least value of the fs,max relation of 9.2.6.2 (SAEngine practice, on the safe side); the durability factor Sd of 9.2.6 is not applied separately: the service stress check stands for it
sources.tanks.surfaceZone: ACI 350-06 7.12.2.1-7.12.2.2: shrinkage and temperature steel 0.003 of the gross section (Grade 60 bars, movement joints less than 9 m apart; 0.004-0.005 for longer spacing, not checked), half at each face, the surface layer at most 300 mm (12 in) for thick sections
sources.tanks.uplift: ASCE 7-22 Sec 2.4.1 combination 7 (0.6D) against the full hydrostatic uplift
